text:
ravi: FYI KovaRed engagement confirmed for Fri 2026-06-11 08:00 PT (6h). Scope: Dedicated + Private console + infra. No production customer data in scope. We need a chain-of-custody plan for evidence, short retest window, and clear RBAC for assessors.

emma: thanks. two asks: 1) evidence integrity verification (hash/signature) so we can prove artifacts weren't modified; 2) retest slot reservation process.

lee: evidence integrity we can do SHA256 + KMS-signature (Sign/Verify). Flow: assessor uploads -> CI job computes sha256 and issues a KMS Sign using `alias/pt-evidence-signing` -> store manifest with `object_key, sha256, signed_by, timestamp`. Only ops service principal can call Verify.

ravi: i like that. keep the signing key separate from encryption key. signing key must have a narrow key policy and be non-exportable.

tasha: RBAC: create ephemeral role `pt/assessor-<vendor>` with `sts:AssumeRole` TTL 5h, permissions s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket, s3:PutObjectTagging. Require `aws:RequestTag/pt-session` on uploads so we tag artifacts with `pt-session=<id>`.

sec-bot: CHECKPOINTS: 1) Ephemeral roles created + AWS tag condition enforced. 2) KMS keys: encrypt key `alias/pt-evidence-enc` (used by SSE-KMS) and signing key `alias/pt-evidence-sign` (Sign/Verify). 3) Object lock (compliance mode) enabled for psuedo-WORM 180d on `pt-evidence` bucket. 4) CloudTrail + S3 data events -> forwarded to SIEM. 5) Evidence manifest template published.

ops: note on object lock -> compliance mode requires bucket-level configuration at creation, we can enable retention via lifecycle with legal hold automation for the window. We'll create `pt-evidence` bucket in a different account (audit account) to minimize blast radius.

emma: about redaction: external reports must never include raw object keys or signing key ARNs. Use tracker IDs and redact keys. Also redact IPs if assessors upload network pcap.

lee: for automation: ci-bot will run a pipeline when S3 inventory notices a new object under `pt-session=` prefix. Pipeline steps: validate upload, compute sha256, call KMS Sign, create manifest JSON, push manifest to GH tracker as comment, tag S3 object `manifest_created=true`.

ci-bot: pipeline template created: `pt-evidence-validate.yml` -> will run in sandbox project `security/pt-automation`. Requires `ci:token` with only necessary scopes.

ravi: retest coordination: propose dry-run 48h prior (Thu 2026-06-09 08:00 PT) to exercise assume role + sign flow + SIEM forwarding. Re-test (actual) booking window 72h after initial fixes, we should block a 2h slot same week.

ops: dry-run scheduled: Thu 2026-06-09 08:00 PT. Invitees: lee, tasha, emma, ops, soc. Will provision ephemeral role and temp presigned URL generator.

sec-bot: ACTIONS: ravi -> create GH tracker and JIRA epic `SEC-PT-2026-KOVAREd`; tasha -> create IAM role templates + tag policy; ops -> provision pt-evidence bucket in audit account + enable object lock; lee -> wire CI pipeline and manifest formatter; emma -> finalize redaction rules for external reports; soc -> add SIEM dashboard for pt-audit feed.

ravi: remediation tracking: each finding gets `pt-<epic>-<num>` tag in GH and must include `evidence_manifest_id` in PRs. SLA: high severity fixes due 7d, medium 14d, low 30d unless vendor requests extension.

emma: note on KMS permissions: signing key must allow `kms:Sign` to CI principal and `kms:Verify` to ops/service-account, deny `kms:GenerateDataKey*` on signing key. encryption key `alias/pt-evidence-enc` will allow `kms:GenerateDataKey` for the presigned path only via KMS grants.

ops: also we should pause automated key rotation for `pt-evidence-enc` from 2026-06-10 through 2026-06-15 to avoid accidental re-encryption. We'll document the pause in key-ops-log.

lee: please remember to put `pt-session` tag on all objects and use stable prefix `pt-evidence/<session-id>/`. CI expects that.

sec-bot: REMINDERS: do not share credentials or presigned URLs in public channels. use secure evidence page: https://internal/evidence-upload -> it logs requestor, session, and returns presigned PUT.

ravi: final check: after dry-run, we'll ask vendor to upload a labeled test artifact `pt-test.txt` and we will validate manifest signature and SIEM entry. If successful, maya (vendor PO) gets scope sign-off and we proceed.

emma: sign-off will be conditional on dry-run green. :white_check_mark:

ops: creating bucket and role templates now; will post ARNs and bucket name in this thread when ready.

sec-bot: NOTE: redact S3 keys in external reports; internal tracker may contain full keys but only referenced by secure links.

ravi: thanks all. will follow up with GH tracker and JIRA epic shortly.

ci-bot: Reminder: dry-run notification will be sent 24h before the scheduled dry-run.
